units.source_text: 夏日的一天晚上，怎麼也擺脫不掉她的糾纏，

en.t: One summer evening, I could not shake off her clinging no matter what,

units.source_text: 只是為了想打發她早點離開，我便在街頭陰暗的角落親吻了她，

en.t: and merely to get her to leave sooner, I kissed her in a dark corner of the street,

units.source_text: 沒料到她興奮得欣喜若狂，叫了一輛計程車，

en.t: but to my surprise she became wildly excited and called a taxi,

units.source_text: 把我帶往他們為了地下運動而祕密租借的一間窄小的洋式辦公室，

en.t: then took me to a narrow Western-style office they had secretly rented for their underground movement,
and made a commotion there all night.

units.source_text: 我不禁暗自苦笑，真是個意想不到的姐姐。

en.t: I could not help smiling bitterly to myself; she was truly an unexpected older sister.

units.source_text: 無論是房東家的女兒，還是這位「同志」，

en.t: Whether it was the landlord's daughter or this comrade,

units.source_text: 我們每天都不得不碰面，所以，不像以前那些女人可以巧妙地躲避，

en.t: I had to see them every day, so unlike the women before, I could not skillfully avoid them,

units.source_text: 最後出於慣有的不安心理，我拼命地討她們倆歡心，

en.t: and in the end, out of my usual anxiety, I desperately tried to please them both,

units.source_text: 結果自己被牢牢地束縛住了。

en.t: with the result that I myself was bound fast.
